framework: Layout, Lattice, Layer, Look, Life, Lens

experience_themes.name: Productive / Data-Dense
experience_themes.psychology: Speed, efficiency, utility, and reduced cognitive latency.
experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model built for high-throughput speed and professional utility.

experience_themes.name: Expressive / Gamified
experience_themes.psychology: Delight, dopamine reward loops, high brand personality, and retention.
experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model built for emotional joy, user engagement, and habit-building.

experience_themes.name: Cinematic / Luxury
experience_themes.psychology: Prestige, status, high brand value, and slow-paced artistic immersion.

layout.typography_size: oversized display headers / tiny body print

look.backgrounds: deep pure blacks / stark whites / muted earth tones
look.accents: subtle grain noise textures / monochromatic palettes

life.feedback_style: cross-fades / sweeping slide reveals / staggered loading cascading

experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model built for premium presentation, editorial authority, and artistic impact.

experience_themes.name: Stealth / Terminal
experience_themes.psychology: Developer focus, hardware efficiency, zero distraction, and technical nostalgia.

look.backgrounds: pure midnight black / true zero-light dark modes
look.accents: high-vis neon green / radioactive amber / raw unstyled code blocks

life.feedback_style: binary active state swaps / stepping frame jumps
life.alerts: blinking cursor loops / terminal stderr console streams

experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model built for absolute low-level latency execution and raw technical power user control.

experience_themes.name: Institutional / Reassuring
experience_themes.psychology: Safety, cognitive accessibility, absolute system trust, and anxiety reduction.

look.backgrounds: pure clinical whites / soft safe tinted backing card blocks
look.accents: reassuring navy blues / calm medical teals / safety check greens

life.feedback_style: highly apparent focus indicators / non-moving state outlines
life.alerts: persistent warning banners / prominent undo confirmations

experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model optimized for universal accessibility, regulatory compliance, and emotional security.

experience_themes.name: Accessible / High-Visibility
experience_themes.lens: Maximum contrast, universal reading assistance, and absolute clarity for all users.

layout.padding: exaggerated hit-targets / thick button bounding boxes
layout.whitespace: generous spacing to prevent accidental clicks

look.borders: thick solid 3px boundaries on active elements
look.backgrounds: pure contrast monochrome (stark white/stark black pairs)
look.accents: pure primary yellow or high-visibility magenta indicators

life.feedback_style: persistent thick dash outline rings on focus/keyboard navigation
life.alerts: static persistent top-bar headers / no flashing transitions

experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model built entirely for WCAG compliance, motor control assistance, and low-vision accessibility.

experience_themes.name: Immersive / AAA Gaming
experience_themes.lens: Atmospheric excitement, state depth, sci-fi/fantasy high tech, and reactive physical feedback.

layout.typography_size: futuristic futuristic weights / small tight telemetry numbers
layout.grid_structure: skewed HUD matrices / nested module containers
layout.whitespace: compact focus frames wrapped by dramatic wide asset banners

look.borders: angled clip-paths / digital crosshairs / technical brackets
look.accents: neon status neon rings / radiant localized active element box-glows

life.feedback_style: continuous parallax depth / mouse-tracking coordinate glides
life.alerts: screen shake triggers / flickering warning glitch text loops

experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model built for extreme sensory engagement, canvas-depth simulation, and entertainment hubs.

experience_themes.name: Organic / Skeuomorphic-Lite
experience_themes.lens: Tactile nostalgia, real-world physics analog, and human-material comfort.

layout.grid_structure: overlapping structural layers resembling stacked paper sheet textures
layout.whitespace: organic breathing spaces mimicking real-world object spacing

look.borders: embossed inner lines / soft multi-layered directional lighting shadows
look.backgrounds: textured canvas / soft cream tints / textured warm elements
look.accents: natural earthy tones / subtle metallic sheen trim highlights

life.feedback_style: depressed card indents on active click / floating elevate-on-hover physics
life.alerts: smooth sliding physical drop trays / elastic pull-to-refresh mechanics

experience_themes.result: An Interaction Model designed for physical reassurance, organic desktop warmth, and tangible user actions.
